mechanism: Phenobarbital induces CYP2C9 and glucuronidation pathways, significantly reducing valproic acid levels, while valproic acid inhibits phenobarbital metabolism, increasing phenobarbital concentrations and CNS depression risk.
action: Monitor valproic acid and phenobarbital levels closely; consider alternative anticonvulsant or adjust doses accordingly; assess for breakthrough seizures and phenobarbital toxicity (sedation, ataxia).
